The Boarded V1 native campaign consists of six component packet branches that diverged from the base native cutover (commit a178c2c, branch loop/boarded-v1-20260905-78720d/native):
1. Native Base (a178c2c): Cutover to approved V1 destinations, models, RPC, and navigation.
2. Native Interactions (e758e51): Interactive sheet presentation and interaction repairs; root branching point for native-feed-visual and native-preview.
3. Feature Packets: native-fixtures (dffc88c), native-journal (4320918), native-feed-visual (d6b1752), native-navigation-measured (9176731).

5. Canonical Preview (f89681d): Formed on branch loop/boarded-v1-20260905-78720d/native-preview by cherry-picking and integrating all fixes across feed visual, navigation, fixtures, journal, and verification drivers. It represents the complete cumulative native implementation.
6. Ephemeral Review Checkout: review-native (detached at a178c2c), an identical clone of the base native worktree.

Integration Gate Status: native-preview (f89681d) passes all functional XCTest UI tests (2/2 passed) but fails the unmasked visual pixel-diff gate (1.99% difference vs 0.5% threshold against the Paper reference). Consequently, it is retained unintegrated until reference/chrome discrepancies are resolved.

Each row was inspected against primary product commit `66e856b` ("feat(web): add Boarded journal, animated landing, and restored board"), historical baseline `a86f0b0`, candidate `e1114ed`, composite `ebd5b8c`, home-link `eebfbc2`, and campaign web-preview/composite references.

### Key Audit Findings
1. **Newer Canonical Retained Candidate:**  
   `/tmp/boarded-app-home-link-20260906` (`eebfbc2d8385519a45290289a24a344c1515547d`, `refs/heads/loop/app-home-link-20260906`) is classified as `keep-canonical`. It embodies the final composite-verified state of the September 6 web loop, connecting brand navigation to the landing page (`href="/"`) while preserving all acceptance fixes (embedded SVG fonts, share caption bounding, native hash focusability).
